sentences.text:
Appu Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March,
2023

Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 58734 of 2022

Applicant :- Appu Kumar Ram
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Asif
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vinod Kumar Ojha
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared on behalf of first informant despite taking the case in revised list.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 149 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366A, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Dubhar, District Ballia, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant/accuse that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

In her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated that on 11.10.2022 she herself has left her home and went to Sikandrabad, where she called the applicant and thereafter they stayed together with her free will and relations were established with her consent.
She has stated that she wanted to marry with applicant and that she has gone from her house at her own free will.
As per school record, the age of victim has been shown about 17 years eight months.

Referring to facts of the Appu Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114088674/
1 matter, it was submitted that no case is made out against the applicant.

entities.text: Appu Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.10.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Appu Kumar Ram involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below subject to following conditions:
1.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2.The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
3.The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5.The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 A. Tripathi  Appu Kumar Ram vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114088674/
